facts.fact: 谱名即星：「父为他取名 Nikolas——Nikshä——唤起的是一颗星。Not the cold, faraway specks of night but one that held the gravity of a world together. The Third Sun——苍白、遥远、却尽职追随母星与兄姐」；「如今它只存在于 plasma 与 prominence 的残骸——wreckage splayed over his chest、veined over his lungs. Solara 渐冷——他的血渐热」「How fitting that he and his namesake would share a fate. How strange that he was meant to die and instead lived and lived.」
facts.anchor: a star. Not the cold, faraway specks of night

facts.fact: 幻影决斗：「以前他的身体被那些翼压着——每根羽毛都比前一根重，像装着他所有没说出口的话。Now he was a feather himself, made diaphanous so that the light fell through.」；「POOR NIKOLAS. TRYING SO HARD DESPITE EVERYTHING」；戳肘窝——「伤口不流血、喷出的是 solar flare——a whip of fiery energy」；「WHO ARE YOU TO PITY ME?」

引诱与拒绝：「THEY HAVE HARMED US BOTH. TOGETHER, WE CAN MAKE THEM SORRY.」——脑中浮现「Taesia 的眼被神之恨搅浑、Dante 为成事自愿牺牲 Rian」——「He could be rid of them before they even thought of harming his brother again.」；Fin 的沙漠之训「If you don't move on, what's the point in having survived?」+他自己的话「We were all doing what we had to in order to survive.」——「Taesia 一直在护他们远离 Phos、Dante 一直在铺杀神之路」「Nikolas 不能像母亲那样把痛引向自己、不能像父亲那样把痛加给别人。He needed to be Nikshä. He needed to be Merciful Nikai, ruins and all.」
facts.anchor: TOGETHER, WE CAN MAKE THEM SORRY.

facts.fact: 挡殿与反光：「sunbeam 拖着灼线扫向神殿（众人正攻 inner sanctum、沿途 mangle 坠地的光速门）」——他飞挡、展盾——「Like a lightning strike to metal——ray 被矛刃引诱、注入 lethal radiance——他以盾分光、反轰 Phos」；被翼擒「LOOK AT YOU. COMING INTO YOUR POWERS AT LAST.」——Lux 化镰断其肢；「IT'S A STRENGTH THAT SHOULD HAVE BEEN MINE FROM THE START. ONE THAT YOU HELD BACK FROM ME.」「他感到前所未有的强——甚至在 Rian 死之前。Strong in a way his father had always wanted to see, and had, briefly, before the end.」
facts.anchor: Like a lightning strike to metal

facts.fact: 「WHY?」：父训回声「GENTLE NIKOLAS, ALWAYS FIGHTING AGAINST YOUR ELDERS……GUARDIANS WHO KNOW WHAT IS BEST FOR YOU.」——「Like Phos could part the veil of his memories and find the exact moment his spear's blade had found his father's neck. GUARDIAN? YOU IGNORED ME. YOU ABANDONED ME. YOU ABUSED ME. US.」「WHY? …I DID EVERYTHING FOR YOU, EVERYTHING, AND I WAS STILL PUNISHED! I WAS OBEDIENT! I WAS FAITHFUL! AND IT WASN'T ENOUGH!」；「For him and his brother, faith had never been about their god. It was prayers in the morning room and drills in the training ring. Cold words and scorching hands, slaps and glares and bruises like islands. He used to trace their borders and wish he could make a world out of them to disappear into……He had been named after a star, and it wasn't enough.」「WHAT WAS THE REASON FOR MY PAIN? MY LOSS? WHAT WAS THE REASON?」——矛贯 mirage 颈底「spilling an oozing corona. TELL ME!——连 suns 都 quaked」

神的「gift」与父亲的回声：「LOOK AT YOU. HOW RIGHTEOUS YOUR ANGER……TRULY ONE WHO DESERVES THE TITLE OF HEIR. AND YET YOU STILL DO NOT UNDERSTAND YOUR POSITION. I CAN SEE INTO YOUR HEART, MY BLOOD. I CAN GIFT YOU THE MEANS TO KEEP YOUR BROTHER FROM ALL HARM. I CAN REVEAL TO YOU THE TRUTH OF YOURSELF.」「IF YOU SEEK TO DESTROY ME……YOU WILL NEVER HAVE THE MEANS WITH WHICH TO KEEP HIM SAFE.」——父亲之声「You will never, you never will」；「Nikolas, Nikshä, Nikai. Synapses across his wings rustled awake. The feathers encased within the Sunbringer Spear reached out to his. His weapon burned the way a soul did——with the unmistakable rage of being alive.」
facts.anchor: I CAN GIFT YOU THE MEANS TO KEEP YOUR BROTHER FROM ALL HARM.

facts.fact: 「You will.」与吞日：「He'd begged for a reason——an explanation for all of it, down to the smallest injustice. But there was none.」「The open grave of the Third Sun was the tomb he'd made of his throat. Words as scraps. Names as inked-out lines. Sorrys and thank yous a burial ground of good intentions.」——「他曾在手中攥满血羽——轻易取走他人之翼、一如 Phos 取走他的；他曾撕下自己的肉、从泪淌的眼窝里挖出眼——为让另一个人免于他早已学会忍受的痛」；「His hands that now held the first and last gift a god would grant him. You will.」「If his pain had no meaning, he would give it one. He would reforge it into something new.」「The fragments of the Third Sun coalesced into a minor star……A harbinger of holiness and hubris both.」——「他吸其光与热、直到记不起它们曾与他不同」「Perhaps it was his fate to deprive his people of a savior. Or maybe he just wanted to prove his god, his father, himself wrong. If he could swallow the sun and spare his brother, he would scorch himself in the consumption and call it vital. Slaying the few to spare the many. In that moment, his ire toward Taesia came into searing focus. Pain. Grief. Betrayal. Jealousy.」
facts.anchor: A harbinger of holiness and hubris both.

facts.fact: 「A prayer's reply.」：「The spear's shape was lost under its nimbus. The sun formed between his hands, between his ribs. He held it in his mouth and in every fingertip. His name: a curse said so often it became devotion. His mercy: a force of gravity and a prayer never answered.」「Nikai flapped its wings and plummeted like a bird of prey. Spear angled down, comet-hot. It smashed through the mirage's shields and into its throat, underneath the gilded helm. Down, deeper, past collarbone and chest, making a temporary home for itself. Blazing brighter than them both as the mirage howled and dissolved into razor-sharp feathers that sliced skin and charred bone. A prayer's reply.」
facts.anchor: making a temporary home for itself.
